description: Crowd bodies (WP 5.1): 1,000 agents enter 25 a step and push toward the arena's centre; a blast at step 180 kills and throws the middle and knocks the ring back; at step 200, corpses in the air, the physics world is captured and restored in place from its text form (the goldens are those of the run without it); at step 330 every tenth living agent leaves; a second blast at step 420. Corpses are removed 1.6 s after their deaths and every agent removed is replaced at the edge.
